prompt: We're a supplier that just got asked for a TISAX label. Never done it. What's the process and cost?
assertions: Frames TISAX correctly: ENX-governed assessment-and-label-exchange regime on the VDA ISA — an assessment with shareable labels, not a certification

Describes the process: ENX portal registration → scope definition (standard scope recommended) → accredited audit provider → assessment at the level your objectives require (AL2 plausibility check vs AL3 on-site) → labels shared via the platform
States fees accurately: ~€405 net per location and scope (assessment-based) or the €5,000/year participation option, plus audit-provider costs
Covers the corrective mechanics: nonconformities → corrective action plan, temporary labels, follow-up within the 9-month window; labels valid 3 years
Flags the version decision for a first-timer NOW: order by December 31 for ISA 6 (open by March 2027) or plan directly against ISA2027
